Container.Name: NetDisc360
Container.Overview: Play your Xbox 360 games from this server over the network, in Aurora, like installed games: no space on the console's drive for the games themselves. NetDisc360 serves ISOs, extracted games and Games on Demand packages to the consoles' NetISO plugin and keeps each console's Aurora game list up to date. Host networking: consoles connect on port 4323, the dashboard is on port 8360.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: The folder with your games: ISOs, extracted games and GOD packages, subfolders too. Read only.

Config.Name: Settings
Config.Description: Where the dashboard keeps its settings (netdisc.ini). Saved passwords are plain text here, so keep it private.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Without one, anyone on your network can open the dashboard and change its settings.

Config.Name: Aurora FTP user
Config.Description: Aurora's FTP login (Aurora: Settings, FTP), to add your games to Aurora.

Config.Name: Consoles
Config.Description: Only these consoles' game folders are kept up to date: IP addresses, separated by commas. Empty: every console that connects.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For the log's times, like Europe/Oslo.
